verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API covering "much of the data in the system" that can be used to "get data out to integrate with other systems." It includes paginated item listing at api.rollbar.com/api/1/items and a published OpenAPI spec, so users can pull their data out in JSON. However, the API explicitly covers only much of the data, not all of it, and there is no evidence of a dedicated bulk or full-account export. missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all account data (items, occurrences, replays, settings), explicit coverage of all data rather than "much," documented open export formats for offboarding, and independent corroboration that a complete export works.
